name: Tortoise Love Story
source:
Tortoise Tortoisson isn't just a lesbian, she's also trying to become a human. On a fateful morning, she falls head over shell for former squirrel Shelly Custard. The road to Tortoise's humanity and her love for Shelly will take courage, fear, and the resolve to change. Will Tortoise make her dreams come true?!

[From [url=https://corinna-vndev.itch.io/tortoise-love-story]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
托托伊丝·托托伊森不仅是一名女同性恋者，还是一只正努力变成人类的陆龟。某个宿命般的清晨，她对曾是松鼠的谢莉·卡斯塔德一见钟情，连龟壳都彻底栽了进去。无论是通往人类之身的道路，还是她对谢莉的爱恋，都需要直面恐惧的勇气与破茧求变的决心。托托伊丝究竟能否如愿以偿、实现梦想？！

[摘自[url=https://corinna-vndev.itch.io/tortoise-love-story]itch.io[/url]]
